item.text:
# VFX Reference Dossier — defensive_dash

## Candidate 1: Rushing Claw / Evasive Swipe (Diablo IV)
- source_game: Diablo IV
- skill_or_mtx_name: Rushing Claw / Evasive Swipe
- primary_url: [Official Spiritborn reveal stream](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VjVUD8eLCFY)
- secondary_urls: [Current Evasive Swipe skill data](https://d4guides.gg/en/database/skills/rushing-claw), [Official Blizzard Spiritborn article](https://news.blizzard.com/en-gb/article/24107497/awaken-the-ferocity-of-a-new-class-spiritborn)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The official stream demonstrates Rushing Claw around 54:33: a short body translation through targets with slashes applied along the crossing. Evasive Swipe converts that motion into an untargeted Evade, making it a direct mechanics-level match; use the stream for base motion and impact rather than the newer variant’s lightning palette.
- readability_notes: The displacement direction and crossed targets remain readable at Diablo IV’s gameplay camera. Repeated casts become harder to separate in dense packs, but individual activations have a clear start-to-contact rhythm.

## Candidate 2: Divine Dash (Athena) (Hades II)
- source_game: Hades II
- skill_or_mtx_name: Divine Dash
- primary_url: [Return of Athena and Divine Dash gameplay](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t3N_IP5Em5A)
- secondary_urls: [Divine Dash mechanics reference](https://hadeswiki.com/wiki/boons/divine-dash), [Divine Dash-only run and discussion](https://www.reddit.com/r/HadesTheGame/comments/sx2ygx)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This is the archetype’s strongest literal match: an instantaneous dash whose active defensive window is communicated by a gold-white deflection flash, followed by reflected-projectile impacts. It demonstrates how protection can be bound to the mover without requiring a persistent path ribbon.
- readability_notes: Hades’ clean top-down staging makes the defensive flash and projectile reversal exceptionally legible. The effect remains recognizable during projectile-heavy combat.

## Candidate 3: Dashing Strike — Blinding Speed (Diablo III)
- source_game: Diablo III
- skill_or_mtx_name: Dashing Strike — Blinding Speed
- primary_url: [Blinding Speed Dashing Strike gameplay guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PbJSoFogT0A)
- secondary_urls: [Official Diablo III skill page](https://eu.diablo3.blizzard.com/en-us/class/monk/active/dashing-strike), [Video guide and exact rune loadout](https://www.icy-veins.com/d3/monk-dashing-strike-cold-build-with-the-raiment-of-a-thousand-storms-set-patch-2-4)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The Monk snaps through enemies, strikes targets along the route, and receives a post-dash dodge bonus from Blinding Speed. Repeated gameplay provides extensive coverage of the translation, contact frame, and recovery into combat.
- readability_notes: The line-to-target movement and contact pop are clear in isolation. Rapid chaining compresses several activations into a flicker, so single-cast frames are the better binding reference.

## Candidate 4: Tidal Dash (Poseidon) (Hades)
- source_game: Hades
- skill_or_mtx_name: Tidal Dash
- primary_url: [Poseidon Dash gameplay run](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BamVo7BTjtQ)
- secondary_urls: [Short knockback-focused gameplay clip](https://www.reddit.com/r/HadesTheGame/comments/13e8t0z), [Tidal Dash mechanics reference](https://www.gamefaqs.gamespot.com/switch/298295-hades/faqs/78659)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: Tidal Dash is an excellent analogue for the Light Feather exemplar: displacement terminates in a compact water burst that damages and knocks enemies away, immediately creating defensive space. The full run supplies many impacts against different enemy densities and arena backgrounds.
- readability_notes: The circular water burst cleanly separates endpoint influence from travel direction. Knockback makes the affected radius readable through enemy motion even when damage effects overlap.

## Candidate 5: Myrmidon Dash Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Myrmidon Dash Effect
- primary_url: [Official Myrmidon Dash showcase](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BWKl2ftetKc)
- secondary_urls: [Official announcement](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3162310), [Official shop listing](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/MyrmidonDashEffect)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This purpose-shot MTX showcase isolates the short dash using a turquoise sequence of watery mirages and a readable arrival resolution. It is a strong surface-treatment reference for communicating rapid displacement, although it does not itself encode a defensive mechanic.
- readability_notes: The controlled environment and repeated casts make the movement envelope unusually easy to study. The mirage trail is more persistent than the archetype’s pathless exemplars, so it should be treated as an optional readability device rather than a geometry requirement.

## Search log
- Searched official Path of Exile Dash/Flame Dash/Frostblink MTX announcements, shop pages, and embedded showcases; retained Myrmidon Dash as the cleanest isolated geometry study.
- Searched Diablo III’s official Monk guide, Dashing Strike rune references, rune-animation compilations, and gameplay builds; paired the official Blinding Speed mechanics with an exact-rune video guide.
- Searched Diablo IV Spiritborn reveal material and current Rushing Claw data; the official stream shows the base move, while current data verifies that Evasive Swipe counts as an Evade.
- Searched Hades and Hades II Divine Dash, Athena deflection, Tidal Dash, and dash-only gameplay; no concise official single-skill reel surfaced, so exact-effect gameplay videos were retained.
- Checked Last Epoch Shift footage and official skill material; not retained because the available footage did not isolate defensive feedback or an impact phase cleanly.
- Checked Grim Dawn Vire’s Might/Blitz and Lost Ark Shield Charge. Both had usable footage, but their sustained charge or persistent-path geometry was a weaker match for the unbanded, pathless target.
